modules.name: Core
modules.summary: Control flow, logic, maths, lists and variables. The language itself.

modules.name: Solana
modules.summary: Token events (trades, volume, holders, fees) and wallet reads.
modules.real: Real on a launched coin · pretend in the builder
modules.note: Real trades, holders and fees on a launched coin. In the builder the Buy, Sell and +10 SOL buttons make pretend events.

modules.name: AI
modules.summary: Agents, ask/choose/classify/summarize, identities, generated text and images.
modules.real: Real on a launched coin · pretend in the builder
modules.note: Paid from the coin's own fees; a coin with no AI credit skips AI. Images need this site's image service.

modules.name: Browser
modules.summary: Web search, opening pages, extracting text, following links, HTTP.
modules.real: Real on a launched coin · pretend in the builder
modules.note: Pages and HTTP calls are real on live coins, through a safe fetcher that only reaches public websites. Search needs this site's search service; a live coin never gets made-up results.

modules.name: Website
modules.summary: Project world: entities, collections, feed, counters, site state and events.
modules.real: Real: state kept in this project

modules.name: Finance
modules.summary: The coin's money: send, buy back, sell, burn, airdrop to holders, and named tallies.
modules.real: Real on a launched coin · pretend in the builder
modules.note: Real on a launched coin: its own vault does it, inside limits that grow with the fees it has earned. Pretend in the builder.

modules.name: Bounties
modules.summary: Bounties, submissions, AI review, approval and rewards.
modules.real: Real: state kept in this project
modules.note: Rewards are real payments from the coin's fees on a launched coin and are pretend in the builder. Anyone can send an entry on the coin's page.

modules.name: Social
modules.summary: Webhooks in and out, posts to X / Discord / Telegram, email.
modules.real: Real on a launched coin · pretend in the builder
modules.note: Webhooks in and out are real on a live coin. Posts to X, Discord and Telegram, and email, are sent for real once what they need is set up under Connections; a coin can't launch without it. Pretend in the builder.

modules.name: Your modules
modules.summary: Modules you declare: events that arrive as webhooks, values you read, actions you send. No code.
modules.real: Real: declared by you, no code
modules.note: Run through the safe web fetcher on live coins and pretend in the builder. Saved inside the coin's rules, so a locked coin never changes.

blocks.label: when trade happens [side]
blocks.tooltip: Runs on every trade of the project token.

blocks.label: when volume changes
blocks.tooltip: Runs whenever traded volume changes.

blocks.label: every [amount] SOL of volume
blocks.tooltip: Runs each time cumulative volume crosses another multiple of the amount.

blocks.label: when creator fees arrive
blocks.tooltip: Runs when creator fees land in the coin's vault.

blocks.label: when market cap crosses [direction] $ [threshold]
blocks.tooltip: Runs once each time market cap crosses the threshold in that direction.

blocks.label: when holder count crosses [direction] [threshold]
blocks.tooltip: Runs once each time the holder count crosses the threshold.

blocks.label: when wallet [wallet] receives funds
blocks.tooltip: BUILDER ONLY. Runs when the given wallet receives a transfer. It never runs on a launched coin; use "when creator fees arrive" instead.

blocks.label: when token graduates
blocks.tooltip: Runs when the token graduates from its bonding curve.

blocks.label: every [minutes] minutes
blocks.tooltip: Runs on a repeating timer.

blocks.label: at time [time] each day
blocks.tooltip: Runs daily at the given local time (HH:MM).

blocks.label: when webhook [path] received
blocks.tooltip: Runs when a request hits this project's webhook path.

blocks.label: when website event [name] happens
blocks.tooltip: Runs when the project website emits the named event.

blocks.label: when agent completes task
blocks.tooltip: Runs after any agent finishes a Run Agent task.

blocks.label: when bounty submission arrives
blocks.tooltip: Runs when someone submits work to an open bounty.

blocks.label: when button [label] pressed
blocks.tooltip: Runs when the named button is pressed in the simulator.

blocks.label: when market cap [direction] $ [amount]
blocks.tooltip: Runs once each time the coin's market cap (in USD) passes this level. After it runs it waits until the market cap has moved back past the level by at least 5% before it can run again, so a coin sitting right on the line does not set it off over and over. Pretend trades move the pretend market cap in the builder; real trades do on a live coin.

blocks.label: when price [direction] by [percent] % within [minutes] minutes
blocks.sentence: when price drops by 20 % within 10 minutes
blocks.tooltip: Runs when the coin's price falls (or climbs) by at least this percent inside this many minutes, measured from the highest (or lowest) price in that time. It runs once for a move, then rests for the same number of minutes. Pretend trades move the pretend price in the builder; real trades do on a live coin.

blocks.label: event [field]
blocks.tooltip: A value from the event that started this script. Fields the event doesn't provide are empty.

blocks.label: coin [stat]
blocks.tooltip: Your coin's numbers right now: market cap in USD, holder count, price per token in SOL, and volume and trades since launch. Simulated in the builder; real once the coin is live.

blocks.label: if ( )
blocks.tooltip: Runs the inner blocks only when the condition is true.

blocks.label: if ( )
blocks.tooltip: Runs one branch or the other depending on the condition.

blocks.label: repeat ( ) times
blocks.tooltip: Runs the inner blocks a number of times.

blocks.label: for each [var] in ( )
blocks.tooltip: Runs the inner blocks once per list item, with the item stored in the variable.

blocks.label: wait ( ) seconds
blocks.tooltip: Pauses this script.

blocks.label: at most once every [seconds] seconds
blocks.tooltip: Skips the inner blocks if they already ran within the cooldown window.

blocks.label: stop [scope]
blocks.tooltip: Ends execution.

blocks.label: run in parallel
blocks.tooltip: Runs both branches at the same time and continues when both finish.

blocks.label: run sequence [name]
blocks.tooltip: Groups blocks into a named, collapsible sequence.

blocks.label: with ( ) % chance
blocks.tooltip: Randomly picks a branch: the first runs with the given probability.

blocks.label: switch on ( )
blocks.tooltip: Runs the branch whose case text equals the value, or the default.

blocks.label: ( ) [op] ( )
blocks.tooltip: Compares two values.

blocks.label: ( ) contains ( )
blocks.tooltip: True if the text contains the substring, or the list contains the item.

blocks.label: ( ) [op] ( )
blocks.tooltip: Combines two conditions.

blocks.label: not ( )
blocks.tooltip: Inverts a condition.

blocks.label: ( ) exists
blocks.tooltip: True if the value is set (not empty).

blocks.label: random chance ( ) %
blocks.tooltip: True with the given probability.

blocks.label: wallet ( ) owns token ( )
blocks.tooltip: True if the wallet holds any of the token. Leave the token empty for your own coin. Read from Solana when live; simulated in the builder for made-up wallets.

blocks.label: [num]

blocks.label: [bool]

blocks.label: list [items]

blocks.label: object [pairs]

blocks.label: current timestamp

blocks.label: ( ) [op] ( )

blocks.label: ( ) % of ( )
blocks.tooltip: A percentage of a number.

blocks.label: [op] of ( ) and ( )
blocks.tooltip: The smaller or larger of two numbers.

blocks.label: random number from ( ) to ( )
blocks.tooltip: A random whole number between the bounds, inclusive.

blocks.label: random item from ( )
blocks.sentence: random item from NVDA, TSLA, AAPL, META, AMD
blocks.tooltip: Picks one item at random.

blocks.label: length of ( )
blocks.tooltip: Number of items in a list.

blocks.label: item ( ) of ( )
blocks.tooltip: The item at a position (1 = first).

blocks.label: [key] of ( )
blocks.tooltip: Reads one field of an object.

blocks.label: join ( ) ( )
blocks.tooltip: Joins two values into text.

blocks.label: [var]
blocks.tooltip: The value of a variable. Variables persist between executions.

blocks.label: set [var] to ( )

blocks.label: append ( ) to list [var]

blocks.label: create agent [species]
blocks.tooltip: Creates a persistent agent entity: unique id, identity, properties, memory, inventory and activity history.

blocks.label: run agent ( )

parts.v: Explore something strange on the web.

blocks.tooltip: Gives the agent a task. The result is an object with response, decision and data.

blocks.label: give ( ) tool [tool]
blocks.tooltip: Permanently grants an agent a tool.

blocks.label: give ( ) an on-chain wallet
blocks.tooltip: SIMULATED in the builder, real on a live coin. Gives the agent its own wallet address (it starts empty). Nothing is spent.

blocks.label: fund ( ) with ( ) SOL from the coin's money
blocks.sentence: fund agent with 0.1 SOL from the coin's money

rows.label: fund ( ) with ( ) SOL from the coin's money

blocks.tooltip: SIMULATED in the builder, real on a live coin. Sets this amount aside for the agent from the coin's claimed fees. The agent can never spend more than it was given.

blocks.label: agent ( ) sends ( ) [asset] to wallet ( )
blocks.sentence: agent agent sends 0.01 SOL to wallet wallet
blocks.tooltip: SIMULATED in the builder, real on a live coin. The agent sends SOL (or a token, by its address) from its own wallet. It counts against the coin's spending limits.

blocks.label: agent ( ) buys ( ) for ( ) SOL
blocks.tooltip: SIMULATED in the builder, real on a live coin. The agent buys with SOL it was given, and what it buys lands in its own wallet. On a live coin an agent can only buy the coin itself ($COIN) or a token by its address. It counts against the coin's spending limits.

blocks.label: search web for ( )
blocks.sentence: search web for strange deep sea creatures

blocks.label: choose image from ( )

blocks.label: create entity of type [entity_type]
blocks.tooltip: Creates a persistent entity that appears in the project world.

blocks.label: set [prop] of entity ( ) to ( )
blocks.sentence: set status of entity entity to value

blocks.tooltip: Adds an item to a named collection shown in the world (shelf, gallery, team…).

blocks.label: post to project feed ( )
blocks.sentence: post to project feed Something happened!
blocks.tooltip: Adds a line to the project feed. {name} inserts a variable.

blocks.tooltip: Changes a public counter displayed on the project site.

blocks.label: set website [key] to ( )
blocks.tooltip: Updates a key in the project website's public state.

blocks.label: AI build website from ( )
blocks.sentence: AI build website from A fun site for my frog coin

parts.v: A fun site for my frog coin

blocks.tooltip: The AI designs your coin's website (title, sections, theme) from your words. It only picks from safe pieces, never raw code.

blocks.label: add website section [kind]
blocks.tooltip: Adds a section to the website. Content: text as is; cards as lines “Title: text”; stats as “Label = holders”; links as “Label | https://...”; image as an address; button as its label.

blocks.label: update website section ( ) (number, title or hero)
blocks.sentence: update website section 1 (number, title or hero)

rows.label: update website section ( ) (number, title or hero)

blocks.tooltip: Changes a website section. Leave a box empty to keep what is there. “hero” changes the top of the page (title, then tagline).

blocks.label: set website theme [theme]
blocks.tooltip: Picks one of the website's ready-made looks.

blocks.label: show notification ( )
blocks.tooltip: Pops a notification in the preview.

blocks.label: SOL balance of wallet ( )
blocks.tooltip: A wallet's SOL balance. Made up in the builder, read from Solana on a live coin. Leave it as "treasury" for the coin's own spendable fees.

blocks.label: treasury [asset]
blocks.tooltip: The coin's collected creator fees that are not spent yet. Pretend numbers in the builder, the real amount on a live coin.

blocks.label: budget [name]
blocks.tooltip: BUILDER ONLY. The current amount in a named budget. A live coin can't keep budgets properly, so don't use budgets in a coin you plan to launch.

blocks.label: send ( ) [unit] to wallet ( )
blocks.tooltip: Sends SOL to a wallet. Pretend in the builder. On a live coin it is a real payment from the coin's own fees, inside its limits.

blocks.label: buy ( ) [unit] of ( )
blocks.tooltip: Buys the coin back with SOL, or buys a tokenized stock (plug in a stock block). Pretend in the builder. On a live coin it is a real buy paid from its own fees: a coin can trade only itself and up to 3 stocks picked at launch. Set “as a percent of” to spend a percent of the event's own amount (e.g. the fees that just arrived) or of the coin's claimable fees instead of the flat amount above; leave it on “nothing” to use the amount as is.

blocks.label: sell ( ) [unit] of ( )
blocks.tooltip: Sells some of this coin that its wallet holds, or a percent of a tokenized stock it holds (plug in a stock block: 50 sells half, 100 sells all). Pretend in the builder, a real sale on a live coin. For the coin itself, on a live coin the number is how many tokens to sell, not an amount of SOL.

blocks.label: add ( ) to budget [name]
blocks.tooltip: BUILDER ONLY. Puts some of the coin's funds into a named budget. A live coin can't use budgets properly (the money can get stuck), so don't use this in a coin you plan to launch.

blocks.label: spend ( ) from budget [name]
blocks.tooltip: BUILDER ONLY. Spends from a named budget. Fails if the budget is too small. A live coin can't use budgets properly, so don't use this in a coin you plan to launch.

blocks.label: budget [name] has at least ( )
blocks.tooltip: BUILDER ONLY. True if the budget holds at least the amount. A live coin can't use budgets properly, so don't use this in a coin you plan to launch.

blocks.label: burn ( ) [mode] of $COIN
blocks.tooltip: Pretend in the builder, real on a live coin. Burns (destroys forever) some of the coin's own tokens held in its wallet. Pick a flat number of tokens, or a percent of what the coin wallet currently holds. A live coin burns for real (an on-chain SPL burn); nothing is sent to anyone, including the project.

blocks.label: airdrop ( ) [mode] of [asset]
blocks.sentence: airdrop 1 a fixed amount of SOL
blocks.tooltip: Pretend in the builder, real on a live coin. Pays holders of this coin. “Top” splits the amount equally among that many top holders; “all” splits it in proportion to what each holder has. “A random” holder pays the whole amount to ONE holder, whatever number you type. The random pick is seeded from the triggering event, so it's the same pick every time this exact event is replayed (recorded in the receipt). A live coin pays at most the launch terms' recipient cap in one run.

blocks.label: split ( ) from budget [from]
blocks.tooltip: BUILDER ONLY. Moves an amount from one budget, divided equally into others. A live coin can't use budgets properly (the money can get stuck), so don't use this in a coin you plan to launch.

blocks.label: a random buyer from the last [minutes] minutes
blocks.sentence: a random buyer from the last 60 minutes

rows.label: a random buyer from the last [minutes] minutes

parts.t: a random buyer from the last

blocks.tooltip: The wallet of one buyer of this coin, picked at random from everyone who bought in that time. Every buyer has the same chance, however many times they bought. Plug it into the wallet slot of Send. The pick is seeded from the event that started the run and written on the receipt. If nobody bought in that time, the Send is skipped and nothing is paid. The coin remembers its last 200 buys. Pretend buys in the builder, real ones on a live coin.

blocks.label: the biggest buyer of the last [minutes] minutes
blocks.sentence: the biggest buyer of the last 60 minutes

rows.label: the biggest buyer of the last [minutes] minutes

parts.t: the biggest buyer of the last

blocks.tooltip: The wallet that bought the most of this coin in that time, counting all of its buys together (in SOL). Plug it into the wallet slot of Send. If nobody bought in that time, the Send is skipped and nothing is paid. The coin remembers its last 200 buys. Pretend buys in the builder, real ones on a live coin.

blocks.label: the latest buyer
blocks.tooltip: The wallet of the most recent buyer of this coin. Plug it into the wallet slot of Send. If nobody has bought yet, the Send is skipped and nothing is paid. Pretend buys in the builder, real ones on a live coin.

blocks.label: buys in the last [minutes] minutes
blocks.tooltip: How many buys of this coin happened in that time. The coin remembers its last 200 buys, so this never counts past 200. Pretend buys in the builder, real ones on a live coin.

blocks.label: create bounty ( )

parts.v: Best meme about our project wins.

blocks.tooltip: Opens a bounty. Pretend in the builder. On a live coin the reward is a real payment from the coin's fees to whoever's entry is approved.

blocks.label: wait for submission to ( )
blocks.tooltip: Marks the bounty as accepting work. Submissions trigger 'when bounty submission arrives'.

blocks.label: [which] submission of ( )
blocks.tooltip: Reads a submission (wallet, content, score, status).

blocks.label: AI review ( )
blocks.tooltip: Returns { score 0-100, approved, feedback }.

blocks.label: approve ( )
blocks.tooltip: Marks the submission approved.

blocks.label: reject ( )
blocks.tooltip: Marks the submission rejected.

blocks.label: pay reward for ( )
blocks.tooltip: SIMULATED in the builder, a real payment from the coin's fees on a live coin. Pays the bounty's reward to the wallet that sent the submission.

blocks.label: send webhook to ( )
blocks.tooltip: POSTs the payload as JSON to a web address. Sent for real once your coin is live (signed if you saved a signing secret); simulated in the builder.

blocks.label: post to [dest]
blocks.tooltip: SIMULATED in the builder: shows exactly what it would post. A live coin posts for real once you add that service under Connections. Limits: X once per 10 minutes, Discord and Telegram once per minute.

blocks.label: email / notify [to]
blocks.tooltip: SIMULATED in the builder: shows exactly what it would send. A live coin emails one address, at most once a minute: the address typed here if Circuit allows that, otherwise the coin owner's own saved address.

blocks.label: stock [symbol]
blocks.tooltip: A tokenized stock, such as NVDA (NVIDIA). Plug it into buy or sell. A coin can trade at most 3 different stocks, picked from 15 and fixed at launch. Tokenized stocks are not the shares themselves.

blocks.label: random stock from [symbols]
blocks.tooltip: Picks one of these tokenized stocks at random each time it runs. Every stock in the list counts toward the coin's 3 stocks.

blocks.label: when module [module] event [event]
blocks.tooltip: Runs when a module's event arrives as a webhook (the same address and secret as any webhook of this coin).

blocks.label: module value [module] [name]
blocks.tooltip: Reads a value from a module's website address. Needs your coin to be live; the builder only simulates it.

blocks.label: module action [module] [name]
blocks.tooltip: Sends the module's request. Needs your coin to be live; the builder only simulates it. A module can never move money.
